tasks.title: Create additive schema migration 009_ai_domain.sql
tasks.description: Add domain column, new forecast targets, binary question type, and reconstructed flag to existing tables
tasks.details:
Create `migrations/009_ai_domain.sql` that:
1. Adds `domain` VARCHAR(20) CHECK(domain IN ('economy', 'ai')) DEFAULT 'economy' to `series` and `questions` tables
2. Adds new values to `forecast_target` enum: `ALTER TYPE forecast_target ADD VALUE 'arxiv_ai_submissions'; ALTER TYPE ... ADD VALUE 'hf_new_models'; ... ADD VALUE 'github_ai_activity'; ... ADD VALUE 'benchmark_sota'; ... ADD VALUE 'largest_training_run'; ALTER TYPE ... ADD VALUE 'ai_binary_event'`
3. Creates new question_type for binary: `ALTER TYPE question_type ADD VALUE 'binary'`
4. Adds `horizon_days INTEGER` to `questions` (nullable, for binary event questions with resolution dates)
5. Adds `question_text TEXT` to `questions` for curated questions
6. Adds `reconstructed BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE` to `observations`
7. Relaxes the FOMC-only CHECK in questions: `ALTER TABLE questions DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS questions_check; ADD CONSTRAINT questions_check CHECK ((target = 'fomc_decision' OR target = 'ai_binary_event') = (question_type = 'probability' OR question_type = 'binary'))`
8. Updates resolutions to support binary: `ALTER TABLE resolutions DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS resolutions_check1; ALTER TABLE resolutions ADD CONSTRAINT resolutions_check1 CHECK (actual_outcome IN ('cut', 'hold', 'hike', 'yes', 'no') OR actual_outcome IS NULL)`
tasks.testStrategy: Run migration via `uv run python -m eco_prediction.db.migrate`. Verify schema changes with `\d+ questions`, `\d+ series`, `\d+ observations`, `\d+ resolutions` in psql. Insert test rows with domain='ai' and verify defaults work. Run existing economy tests to ensure backward compatibility. Test that binary questions can be created with horizon_days.

tasks.title: Create LLM call logging tables and retrieval corpus
tasks.description: Add database tables for LLM forecaster: llm_calls for tracking prompts/responses, retrieval_documents for point-in-time context
tasks.details:
Create migration `migrations/010_llm_tables.sql`:

```sql
CREATE TABLE llm_calls (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    forecast_id INTEGER REFERENCES forecasts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    model_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,  -- e.g., 'claude-opus-4-20250514'
    prompt TEXT NOT NULL,
    context_hash VARCHAR(64),  -- hash of input context for deduplication
    raw_response TEXT NOT NULL,
    input_tokens INTEGER,
    output_tokens INTEGER,
    cost_usd NUMERIC(10, 6),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_llm_calls_forecast ON llm_calls(forecast_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_llm_calls_model ON llm_calls(model_id);

CREATE TABLE retrieval_documents (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    document_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,  -- 'arxiv_abstract', 'release_note', 'metaculus_question', etc.
    source_id VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,  -- arXiv ID, GitHub release URL, etc.
    content TEXT NOT NULL,
    published_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,  -- for point-in-time filtering
    metadata JSONB,  -- tags, categories, etc.
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    UNIQUE (document_type, source_id)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_retrieval_published ON retrieval_documents(published_at);
CREATE INDEX idx_retrieval_type ON retrieval_documents(document_type);
```

Create `src/eco_prediction/ai/llm/retrieval.py`:
- Function `retrieve_documents(conn, as_of_date, query_type, limit=10)` for point-in-time retrieval
- Function `index_arxiv_abstracts(conn)`, `index_release_notes(conn)`, etc. to populate corpus
